info.cls_ename: Department of Industrial Engineering and Systems Management

description.describe_ch: 工業工程是台灣產業發展的重要關鍵，從傳統製造到現今智慧製造，都需要工業工程管理的專業人才，為使初出校園的工管畢業生，可以盡快適應與融入職場，本課程將模擬職場情境，引導學生學習職場的人際互動、工作目標設定及因應組織相關策略與機制成長，降低面對新工作的壓力與困惑，縮短職場新鮮人的適應期，提升職場競爭力。
description.describe_eh:
Industrial engineering is an important key for Taiwan’s industrial development. Both traditional manufacturing and smart manufacturing are needed industrial engineering management professional. In order to enable IESM graduates adapt and integrate into the workplace as soon as possible.
This course is designed real working situations to lead students learn how to deal with their working events, such as interaction with others, setting task goal and growth through organizational strategy. Reducing the pressure and confusion of new graduate employees in the workplace when they facing new job, and shortening the adaptation period to enhance workplace competitiveness.

targets.describe_ch: A.引導學生作好工管職場新鮮人的準備
targets.describe_en: Guide industrial engineering management students to prepare themselves as graduate employees in the workplace

targets.describe_ch: B.瞭解工管人在職場中的各種情境事件與因應之道
targets.describe_en: Understand various situations and events in the industrial engineering management workplace and how to respond to them

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生正確的自我管理與工作態度
targets.describe_en: Cultivate students’ correct self-management and work attitudes

targets.describe_ch: 建立學生問題解決、人際互動與團隊合作的職場能力
targets.describe_en: Build students’ workplace skills in problem solving, interpersonal interaction and teamwork.
